hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; [ -z "$f" ] && f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.py) ./venv/bin/ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac

f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; [ -z "$f" ] && f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.claude-plugin/plugin.json) c="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_new_string"; [ -z "$c" ] && c="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_content"; if echo "$c" | grep -qE '"author"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"'; then echo 'BLOCKED: plugin.json author must be an object {name, email}, not a string. Claude Code silently fails the manifest schema check on the string form.' >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac
